entities.summary: Ramo Peter "Ray" Ceresino was a Canadian ice hockey left winger. He played 12 games for the Toronto Maple Leafs of the National Hockey League during the 1948–49 season. The rest of his career, which lasted from 1946 to 1957, was spent in the minor leagues.
